purpose.zh: 练躯干稳定和对侧手脚协调
purpose.en: Build trunk stability and opposite arm-leg coordination.

text.zh: 对侧手脚伸远，躯干保持水平不动
text.en: Reach the opposite arm and leg long while your trunk stays level

text.zh: 四足跪撑，手在肩下，膝在髋下
text.en: Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.

text.zh: 腿伸到髋高、手到肩高，停住再收回
text.en: Reach the leg to hip height and the arm to shoulder height, hold, then return.

commonErrors.en: Sagging the lower back or rotating the pelvis.

cautions.zh: 腰部疼痛时减小伸展幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reach less if your lower back hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
